title: Container Bookings: late SI free allowance on dangerous-goods bookings
content:
## Rule
For late shipping instructions on a Container Bookings booking, the free allowance is open for every booking whose cargo category is not dangerous goods. A booking with dangerous-goods cargo has it only when at least one of its dangerous-goods acceptances is approved with a positive container count, because documents for goods the line has not cleared are not treated as routine lateness.

The approval and its container count are read from the booking's dangerous-goods acceptance records.

## Condition table
| Cargo category | Dangerous-goods acceptances | Free allowance open |
|---|---|---|
| any category other than dangerous goods | not relevant | yes |
| dangerous goods | at least one approved with a positive container count | yes |
| dangerous goods | none approved, or approved only with no containers | no |
